rule: An oracle may read a live value from the running product only when it is listed here. The runner self-check rejects the runner if any oracle reads a live value that is not listed, or uses a listed one beyond its stated role.

exceptions.whyNotTheSystemUnderTest: The settings navigation UI is under test; the types route is the backend schema list the navigation is compared against, and the frozen settings-routes.json supplies the expected sections.
The realtime snapshot writer is under test; the REST catalog path is a separate reader that the row records as passing on the baseline (SCN-IDN-001), and frozen sample rows are compared first.
The sidebar thread mirror is under test; the sessions API is the server record it must mirror.
Expected control kinds and values come from schema-controls-oracle.json; the API read-back only confirms the saved value reached the server.

exceptions.endpoint: option endpoints named in free-text-inventory.json optionSources
exceptions.whyNotTheSystemUnderTest: The free-text inventory is frozen; the endpoints only supply the option set each picker must equal.
Expected fields come from the frozen skill-import/valid/SKILL.md; the listing confirms the import was stored.
The built-in tool set has no committed source; tool options must be a subset of this list, so a wrong picker that offers a non-existent tool is caught, but one that drops a tool is not.
Agent filter options must contain the frozen seeded agents and be a subset of this list.
After the owner closes, the stored row must equal the survivor's graph; the pre-edit digest is a recorded pre-action observation.
Expected end count is this observation plus the frozen expectedCountDelta.

exceptions.endpoint: thread, message and entity counts from the baseline build before upgrade
exceptions.whyNotTheSystemUnderTest: The upgrade must preserve what the previous build stored.

exceptions.endpoint: lkg/config.yaml digest before the refusal edit
exceptions.whyNotTheSystemUnderTest: The refusal must leave the last-known-good file byte-identical.

exceptions.endpoint: the provider edited through the API before restart
exceptions.whyNotTheSystemUnderTest: The surviving provider must keep the edit the runner made.

exceptions.endpoint: server event emission timestamp and the worker-unregistered run's latency
exceptions.whyNotTheSystemUnderTest: Timing is compared with the same page with the worker unregistered; no expected value is taken from the worker under test.

exceptions.endpoint: main-thread filter output in the same page
exceptions.whyNotTheSystemUnderTest: The worker is under test; the main-thread functions are the reference it must equal.

exceptions.endpoint: Agents and Skills pages' own save results
exceptions.whyNotTheSystemUnderTest: The settings entry is under test; the owning page is the single editing surface it links to.
